references.name: principal-front.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected wide street facade: central large iron-and-glass pitched train-shed gable, flanking ornate yellow/pink brick pavilions, four corner domed towers with narrow arched windows, a broad curved mansard/arched central pavilion roof and clock, pale cornices, blue-gray metal ornament and tall recessed timber/glazed entrances. Trees partly obscure lower central frontage; hidden opening inventory needs coherent original interpretation. No copied signs, advertisements, logos, tram, poles, crowds or street wires.

references.name: track-side.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected track-side photograph: rear pitched iron-and-glass hall end, tall brick corner piers with small domed caps, open lower train approach, visible roof framing and side glazing. Trains obscure some lower inventory. Do not close the train entry with a solid wall or manufacture a floor over native railway corridors. Contemporary outer canopies require map inventory before deciding scope.

note: Two adequate ordinary pictures actually inspected, plus current standard PMTiles. No bespoke sources or further research needed before geometry. Hidden details and heights remain explicit medium-fi approximations.
